question: Why is the embodiment of Nivritti and the other kalas not distinctly perceived?
premises: Nivritti and the other kalas are extremely subtle.
Their embodiment, though begun from earth and so on, is absorbed in the flashing great knowledge of the Mother.
inference: Because of subtlety and absorption in the Mother's great knowledge, their embodiment is not distinctly perceived.
uncertainties: The compound dharādyārabdhadehatā is compressed; the sense is that embodiment is initiated from earth onward.
plain_english: Because Nivritti and the other kalas are extremely subtle, their embodiment, though begun from earth and so on, is not distinctly perceived, since it is absorbed in the flashing great knowledge of the Mother.
